newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian markets end mixed in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Colombian markets end mixed in light trade.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended mixed after a day of extremely light trading due, at least in part, to the closure of U.S. markets and absence of foreign funds on the July 4 holiday, brokers said.

Medellin's IBOMED .IBMG general price index edged up 0.13 percent at 18,255.72 on trading of 674 million pesos. But Bogota's IBB .IBB price index closed down 0.19 percent at 1,196.66 on volume far below-average of 607 million pesos.
Brokers said the return of foreign funds Monday could push Colombian markets upward.

Banco de Bogota, the country's third largest bank in terms of assets, finished down 0.72 percent at 6,850 on 172 million pesos traded in Bogota, but rose 0.73 percent to 6,850.01 on 66 million in Medellin.
Giant brewer Bavaria ended up 0.12 percent to 8,210 on 198 million pesos traded in Bogota, but it held steady at 8,200 in Medellin.
